title: Dendera light bulb relief

tellings.quote: That we I mean, you go down to like the Dendara temples in Egypt where you've got the light bulb, you know, the the kind of the classic light bulb.

plain: At the Dendera temples in Egypt there is an ancient stone carving that looks like a light bulb, says a guest named Jay Anderson, who speaks of having gone there. He calls it the classic light bulb carving. He brings it up as a sign that the ancient world may have known more than we think, perhaps even electric light.
